Johnny Somali whose real name is Ramsey Khalid Ismael seems is not only having to serve 6 months and 20 days of “hard labor” while imprisoned in South Korea, but it’s also being reported he will have to register as a s3x 0ff3nder when he is deported back to the US after serving his sentencing #fafo #johnnysomali #hankyoo #southkorea #ramseykhalidismael

Amalia and her parents were eventually released without Amalia’s birth certificate, her vaccination records, or her medication. And reminder, if someone d!3s from a health issue after being released it doesn’t get recorded as a dxxth in their “detention center” which helps for international optics bc the US is already on a humanitarian crisis list. #dilley #immigrant #protectchildren

Oudone (Don) Lothirath is now in hospice BECAUSE of the medical neglect while he was illegally detained. And as a law abiding citizen for the last 24yrs after serving 6 months in 2001 for being the driver while his friend pulled a piu piu out and shxt someone’s license plate, he shouldn’t have been served an accelerated dxxth sentence. If you are able pls help out Oudone Lothirath. #OudoneLothirath #lao #immigrant #fdt

That’s one of Archie’s favorite spots in the house bc he can see everything without worrying about Colt bulldozing him over. And yes ofc they bring me great joy but boy these plants bring a smile to my face too. #plants #orchid #zombieorchid #plantdaddy #dopamine

Thank you to the father for never giving up and to the Pro Bono Asylum  Representation Project for saving the 3yo from our abusive system. The trauma she will carry for the rest of her life was completely avoidable and is our government’s fault. #protectchildren #immigrants #proboboasylumproject #couragenow
